items.title: Honeywell Aerospace shares plunge as company cuts 2026 sales outlook
items.summary: Investing.com -- Honeywell Aerospace lowered its 2026 sales growth forecast and issued a weaker-than-expected earnings outlook on Wednesday, as ongoing supply-chain constraints limited its ability to keep pace with surging aftermarket demand.

items.title: Honeywell Technologies Posts Higher Profit, Revenue Amid Restructuring

items.title: Honeywell Aerospace (HONA) Lands IndiGo Deal For 810 Airbus A320neo Family Jets
items.summary: IndiGo has selected Honeywell Aerospace to supply avionics and auxiliary power units for 810 Airbus A320neo-family aircraft. The agreement covers equipment and long-term aftermarket support for what is described as the largest such deal in Honeywell Aerospace’s history. This contract expands Honeywell Aerospace’s role within IndiGo’s fleet plans and adds scale to its commercial aviation equipment and services portfolio.
